articles.description: India recovered from 70 for 5 to chase down 181 in Christchurch after New Zealand's poor fielding reprieved four India batters

articles.description: He said conversations before this game with Gambhir and Kotak helped reinforce belief in his abilities

articles.title: Pakistan leave out Masood, Sajid and Noman for home Tests against SL
articles.description: Fourteen-member squad includes Salman Agha, Mohammad Suleman, Minhas brothers and Razaullah. Two more seamers will be added after a three-day tour game against the visitors

articles.title: 'The small stuff can change games quickly' - Santner rues dropped catches and misfields
articles.description: The New Zealand captain acknowledged his team was 'in a very good position' but their errors in the field let India recover from 70 for 5 to chase down 181

articles.title: Pollard: 'Nothing is going to faze me' as MI head coach

articles.title: President's Trophy final shifted again, this time from Karachi to Lahore
articles.description: The final will now be played at the Bagh-e-Jinnah Park and will start on October 27, two days after it was originally scheduled to start

articles.title: Pakistan name squad for Sri Lanka Tests: Salman Agha back, Rizwan still out
articles.description: Pakistan have recalled Salman Agha and Ali Usman for the two-Test home series against Sri Lanka, while Mohammad Rizwan remains excluded following the England tour debacle.

articles.title: WPL 2027 Auction: 5 overseas players who could attract big bids
articles.description: The Women's Premier League 2027 auction takes place in Kochi on October 28, and several overseas names are set to generate serious interest from franchises.

articles.title: 'Boys becoming Men': Gautam Gambhir lauds India's youngsters after gutsy 2nd T20I win vs New Zealand
articles.description: India recovered from 70 for 5 to chase down 181 and seal a four-wicket victory at Hagley Oval, with Gambhir posting a three-word tribute to his young match-winners.

articles.title: 'The entire momentum changed from there' – Ajinkya Rahane lauds Naman Dhir's cameo in 2nd T20I vs New Zealand
articles.description: Ajinkya Rahane highlighted how Naman Dhir's aggressive 31-run knock off 17 balls transformed India's chase against New Zealand in the second T20I at Christchurch.

articles.title: 'India pulled off a heist in front of New Zealand's eyes'  - Dinesh Karthik on enthralling finish in 2nd T20I
articles.description: Dinesh Karthik praised India's remarkable chase at Hagley Oval, Christchurch, where the visitors scored 68 runs in the final 4.5 overs to claim a four-wicket victory.

articles.title: Tom Banton happy to pause red-ball cricket in pursuit of England World Cup place
articles.description: The Somerset batter signed a white-ball only county deal in June 2026 and has since broken back into England's ODI and T20 setups under Harry Brook.

articles.title: Ajinkya Rahane, Vivek Razdan's samosa banter during India vs New Zealand 2nd T20I draws flak
articles.description: Former India captain Ajinkya Rahane and commentator Vivek Razdan's on-air discussion about samosas during the second T20I between India and New Zealand at Christchurch sparked criticism from viewers.

articles.title: 'Josh Hazlewood-like accuracy' - Ian Smith reacts to Prince Yadav's peach to clean up Finn Allen in 2nd T20I
articles.description: Prince Yadav uprooted Finn Allen's leg stump with a full, straight delivery on October 24, 2026, drawing high praise from commentator Ian Smith during the 2nd T20I.

articles.title: [WATCH] Tilak Varma's emotional outburst after scripting India's thrilling heist vs NZ in 2nd T20I
articles.description: Tilak Varma held back his celebration after reaching fifty and only released his emotions once Nitish Kumar Reddy sealed the win off the penultimate ball at Hagley Oval.

articles.title: India become second team after Pakistan to play 300 T20Is
articles.description: India reached the 300 T20I milestone on October 24, 2026, during the 2nd T20I versus New Zealand at Hagley Oval, Christchurch, joining Pakistan as the only nations to cross this mark.
